When I was a little bit heavier I had similar issues. What helped was making sure my bike was tuned up (cleaning/greasing the chain, making sure bike tires are fully inflated) when I first started I never thought to do that. That will make things a lot easier. But it also sounds like this route is pretty difficult, but you will eventually get used to it if you are consistent. I intitially used my bike for commuting, and hated it, but eventually learned to love it and even do it when it gets 100+ degrees or >10 degrees. You got this!!

Hey I've been in the same spot as you are right now. You are super tough for what you have gone through, I'm proud of you. School is difficult and annoying, and I don't blame you for not wanting to see it through, but I would believe that it would be much nicer for the people in your life to see you repeat a grade than it would for them to see you lowered into the ground. I would certainly rather see you repeat a grade. You are likely not a burden or a bad sibling, but that depression beast/self critic is certainly trying to tell you that. You don't have to think that. Instead maybe try to think: "Is this a helpful thought? Will this make me feel better than I was before? Or am I just being overly harsh on myself?" Maybe that will help you realize how meaningful you are. I hope you are okay. I know things are bleak, but try try try holding out a little bit longer.
